svg.title: Controlled-mindset citation network
svg.desc: Arrows point from citing to cited opinions. Circle area grows with incoming controlled-mindset citations, with a minimum area for readability. Colors identify doctrinal connections. Concentric bands have equal visible areas. Selecting a node only highlights citation connections.

svg.text: 50 connections: solid = controlled mindset; dashed = other citations, including appellate review and history.
Circle size reflects incoming controlled-mindset citations, with a minimum size to keep every opinion visible. Each color marks affirmative judicial recognition that
controlled mindset is relevant to a legal inquiry, even if insufficient on its own or unsupported on the facts. Mere distinctions are not colored. Gray marks no affirmative
doctrinal use. Multiple colors occupy equal visible areas within each circle. Click a case to highlight its citation connections and matching legend colors; click it again or
the background to clear. Click a color label to highlight all cases with that doctrinal use, without highlighting citations.
